headword: {男女|だんじょ}{平等|びょうどう}

definitions.gloss: gender equality; equality between men and women
definitions.explanation: The principle that men and women should have equal rights, opportunities, and treatment. A key concept in social discussions, law, and policy in Japan.

examples.japanese: {男女|だんじょ}{平等|びょうどう}は{大切|たいせつ}だ。
{男女|だんじょ}{平等|びょうどう}の{実現|じつげん}に{向|む}けて{努力|どりょく}する。
examples.english: To work toward achieving gender equality.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}では{男女|だんじょ}{平等|びょうどう}の{意識|いしき}が{少|すこ}しずつ{広|ひろ}がっている。
examples.english: In Japan, awareness of gender equality is gradually spreading.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound noun combining {男女|だんじょ} (men and women) and {平等|びょうどう} (equality). Frequently used in news, education, and policy discussions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {男女|だんじょ}{平等|びょうどう}{社会|しゃかい} (gender-equal society)
- {男女|だんじょ}{平等|びょうどう}の{実現|じつげん} (realization of gender equality)
- {男女|だんじょ}{平等|びょうどう}{指数|しすう} (gender equality index)

RELATED WORDS:
- {男女|だんじょ}{共同|きょうどう}{参画|さんかく}: gender-equal participation — the official term used in Japanese government policy
